definitions: A sharp projection near the end of an arrow, fish-hook, or similar object, which is angled away from the main point so as to make extraction difficult.
A kind of horse, typically a small, hardy, and swift one, originally bred in North Africa.
A beard-like growth on a plant.
One of the parallel filaments projecting from the main shaft of a feather.
examples: The barb of the arrow was lodged deep.
She delivered a barb about his fashion sense.
The rider mounted his Barb and galloped away.
The rose stem had tiny barbs.
Each barb of the feather was perfectly aligned.
